description:
Pin the new on-disk shape in ARCHITECTURE.md before any code change.
Implementation phases reference these sections; coining in code first
violates the v0.3 layout migration's standing rule.

=== Sections to amend ===

§2.2 Conversation Repo: directory listing gains a steps/ subdir
at the conv-repo root (alongside manifest.yaml, workflow.yaml,
providers.yaml, version, souls/). Worktree listings drop steps/
from their per-worktree shape. Add a sentence: step records
are diagnostic/audit, not context; the worktree-as-context
principle (§3.5, §5) excludes them by structure.

§2.3 Step on-disk: relocate the path from
'<worktree>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/' to
'<conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/'. Add 'commit:' field to
the step record (branch tip at step-start). Note that
recoverability of the wire request rests on replaying the
assembler against that commit; the on-disk request.json is
diagnostic.

§2.10 Snapshot before model call: step 1 commits the dispatch
artifacts (goal.md + soul.md) on the new branch; step ≥2 takes
no pre-call commit (the prior step's tip is the read state).
Strike the 'commit request.json before the model call' line.

§3.5 UI contract: watch path for streaming text moves to
'<conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/response.json'. Pin the
tail-f-with-fd-close completion signal: writer closes the fd,
inotify IN_CLOSE_WRITE marks the response complete.

§4.4 Adapter response on disk: response.json is JSONL of §4.4
stream events, regardless of whether the adapter ran in
streaming or non-streaming mode (non-streaming is a single
message_start..message_stop sequence). Pin that this is the
on-disk shape; the wire-side shape distinction collapses on
disk.

§5 Manifest scope: clarify that worker.order: never references
the steps/ tree — step records are not context. Update the
example/template manifest accordingly (the trim itself ships in P2).

=== Constraints ===

- Docs-only PR. No code change in this phase.
- Cross-reference all amendments so §X.Y links resolve internally.
- Update TAXONOMY.md only if a new term gets coined; otherwise no
  change.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md (alignment for this phase is
a self-consistency read of the amended doc against PRINCIPLES.md
and any unchanged sections).
title: v0.3.1 P1: ARCH amendment for step records out of worktree
